Plot Consensus Matrix Heatmap

Source: R/aether_consensus_plots.R
AETHER_plot_consensus_matrix.Rd

Plots the averaged consensus matrix for a chosen k as a heatmap. Samples are reordered by cluster assignment, making block structure visible. Dark blue = always co-clustered; white = never co-clustered.

Usage

AETHER_plot_consensus_matrix(cc_result, k, title = NULL)

Arguments

cc_result

Output of ARTEMIS_consensus_cluster().

k

Integer. Number of clusters to display.

title

Character. Plot title. If NULL, auto-generated. Default = NULL.

Value

A ggplot object.
